entries.referenceText: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? [30] Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing ‘eco-friendly’ products, probably because they feel licensed to do so since they morally account the ‘eco-friendly’ choice as a ‘good’ deed. Moral licensing has also been observed in cooperation for the environment. When people are reminded of environmentally harmful deeds, they may feel ‘eco-guilt.’ People who experience eco-guilt seek pro-environmental actions to compensate and restore balance. In their search for such a balance, people are inclined to believe in ‘quick-fixes,’ because they want to ____________. ① justify dishonest behavior by blaming external factors ② ignore evidence of environmental degradation ③ demand substantial long-term systemic reforms ④ avoid future pro-environmental engagement ⑤ swiftly restore their moral balance and escape guilt with minimal effort

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은? [30] Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing ‘eco-friendly’ products, probably because they feel ① licensed to do so since they morally account the choice as a good deed. When people are reminded of deeds they have done ② that were harmful to the environment, they might feel eco-guilt. People seek actions to compensate and restore balance. They want to re-establish the balance and ③ escape guilt quickly. People may change attitudes to ④ reduce inconsistencies and may sign a petition ⑤ addressed environmental damage after viewing evidence of human-caused damage.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은? [30] Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing ‘eco-friendly’ products because they feel ① authorized to do so after morally counting the choice as a good deed. When reminded of deeds ② detrimental to the environment, they may feel eco-guilt. They seek pro-environmental actions to compensate and ③ disrupt balance. In their search for balance, they seek quick-fixes to escape guilt quickly and easily.

주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은? [30] Some people are more likely to cheat and steal after purchasing ‘eco-friendly’ products because they feel licensed by the good deed. (A) People who experience eco-guilt seek pro-environmental actions to compensate and restore balance, often preferring quick-fixes. (B) Moral licensing is also observed in environmental cooperation; reminders of harmful deeds can leave people with eco-guilt. (C) People may change evaluations of past and future behaviors and are more likely to sign environmental petitions after seeing evidence of human-caused damage. ① (A)-(C)-(B) ② (B)-(A)-(C) ③ (B)-(C)-(A) ④ (C)-(A)-(B) ⑤ (C)-(B)-(A)

글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? [30] [주어진 문장] In their search for such a balance, people are inclined to believe in ‘quick-fixes,’ because they want to re-establish moral balance and escape guilt quickly. Some people may cheat after eco-friendly purchases because of moral licensing. (①) Moral licensing also occurs in environmental cooperation. (②) Harmful environmental deeds can cause eco-guilt. (③) People with eco-guilt seek pro-environmental actions to compensate and restore balance. (④) People may change evaluations of past and future behaviors. (⑤) They may sign petitions after viewing evidence of environmental damage.

다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은? [30] The passage explains how moral licensing after an eco-friendly deed can permit unethical behavior, while eco-guilt can motivate compensatory environmental action and quick-fixes to restore moral balance. ① Moral Licensing and Eco-Guilt: The Two Sides of Moral Balance ② Why Environmental Damage Never Changes Behavior ③ The Economic Cost of Green Consumption ④ Long-Term Policy Solutions for Climate Change ⑤ How Technology Eliminates Environmental Guilt

(주관식) 다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말을 본문에서 찾아 각각 한 단어로 쓰시오. [30] While purchasing eco-friendly products can lead to moral (A) that licenses dishonest behaviors, the feeling of eco-guilt motivates people to seek quick-fixes to (B) for their past harmful deeds. (A) ______ (B) ______
